philosophy: Zeroaxis is an established technology business that focuses on doing the work properly. Not a flashy startup landing page. Simple, Professional, Trustworthy, Mature, Clean, Business-like.

rules.headings: Merriweather. Keep letter-spacing normal to slightly tight. Avoid oversized headings. Max text-4xl or text-5xl on desktop hero.
rules.body: IBM Plex Sans. Highly readable. Use leading-relaxed for body text.
rules.weights: Use 400 and 700. Avoid thin or extreme black weights to keep a standard, document-like feel.

visual_enhancers.radii: Strictly rectangular or soft-rounded (max rounded-sm / 2px to 4px). NO pill shapes except maybe for small status badges.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Very minimal. Use shadow-sm for cards. Avoid deep or colored shadows.
visual_enhancers.effects: NO glassmorphism, NO neon effects, NO excessive gradients. Solid colors only.

component_rules.cards: Traditional rectangular containers. White background, 1px gray border, rounded-sm, slight shadow-sm. Padding p-6.
component_rules.buttons: Standard solid rectangular buttons. bg-[#00509E] text-white rounded-sm px-6 py-2 hover:bg-[#003E7A]. No pills.
component_rules.forms: Traditional inputs. White background, 1px solid gray border, rounded-sm. Focus state should be a simple blue ring (ring-1 ring-[#00509E]).
component_rules.tables: Use simple, clean data tables for admin and dashboard. Avoid oversized visual cards for data. Left-aligned text, standard row heights.
component_rules.navigation: Classic solid background header. DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for header. Show links plainly. Logo left, links center, action right.
component_rules.icons: Use 'lucide-react'. Keep them small and functional. No oversized decorative icons.

grids.marketing: Standard 12-column grid. Max-width containers (max-w-7xl). Symmetrical or simple 2-column (text on left, image on right) layouts. Padding py-16 or py-24 for sections.
grids.admin: Traditional layout: 250px fixed sidebar, flex-1 main content area. Topbar inside main content.
grids.dashboard: Use CSS Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4) for top-level stats, then full-width rows for tables.

home_page: Hero (Traditional left-align text, right-align standard rectangular image)
Main Services (Simple grid of rectangular cards)
layouts.customer_dashboard: Sidebar/TopNav hybrid. Sections: Overview, My Enquiries, My Orders, Tracking (vertical timeline), Notifications, Profile.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Classic control-panel. Left Sidebar (Dashboard, Customers, Enquiries, Orders, Payments, Services, Notifications, Messages, Invoices, Content, Reports, Audit, Settings). Table-heavy content views.

motion.allowed: Subtle button hover (color darken), very small fade-in for page load. Smooth page transitions.
motion.forbidden: NO moving backgrounds, NO parallax, NO animated gradients, NO flashy transitions, NO bouncy physics.

accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AA minimum. High contrast text on backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

hero_office.description: Professional team collaborating in a well-lit corporate office. Use for Hero or About Us.

programmer_ayaan.description: Focused software developer team. Use for Main Programmer (Ayaan) or Experience section.

technology_services.description: Server rack filled with network and electronic equipment. Use for Services or IT background context.

responsive.layout: Stack columns vertically on mobile. Admin sidebar should become an off-canvas menu behind a hamburger icon on mobile.
responsive.typography: Scale headings down on mobile (h1 to text-2xl/3xl, body remains text-base).
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure tables have 'overflow-x-auto' wrappers to prevent breaking the layout on mobile.
responsive.tap_targets: Buttons and links must be at least 44x44px for touch capability.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a classic, established corporate website using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI.
Do NOT make it look like a modern flashy SaaS. It must look mature, trustworthy, and business-like.
Use Merriweather for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text. Install these via Google Fonts.
Use solid white or light gray backgrounds. No glassmorphism or gradients.
Use purely rectangular or slightly rounded (rounded-sm) elements. Avoid rounded-full or pill shapes.
For the Admin Dashboard, use a classic sidebar control-panel layout with standard data tables instead of large modern cards.
Implement clear navigation visible on desktop without a hamburger menu (except for admin/dashboard sidebar).
Do not center-align body text. Keep text left-aligned for readability.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
Make the application strictly mobile-responsive. Stack grids on small screens and use overflow containers for tables.
Use the provided image URLs to substitute placeholders.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create distinctive, non-generic frontend layouts that respect the exact business requirements.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Stick to solid colors.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container. Respect natural reading flows.
NEVER use AI assistant emojis. Use lucide-react icons.
Prioritize Shadcn UI components but heavily customize their classes to remove the 'default' modern SaaS look (make borders 1px solid, reduce border radius to sm, remove heavy shadows).
Ensure standard semantic HTML structure (header, main, section, footer).
